brief: Two bins to sort my dead AA batteries for recycling.

requirements.evidence: Two adjacent full bases (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) each with a hex-bin-full bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full), joined by lockJoints.

requirements.requirement: Bins sized to sort/collect dead AA batteries for recycling
requirements.evidence: Open-top full-depth bins (142x124 mm floor, 77 mm deep) in adjacent cells: AA cells lying down or standing fit easily and dead cells can be dropped in, separated from other contents; open top keeps walk-up drop-in use.

No AA battery prop exists in the prop catalog (battery/AA/cell searches returned none), so each bin holds a heap prop (prop:1, prop:2) to show loose small items collected for sorting/recycling; look from above (polar 10) confirms both heaps are visible inside the rims.

finish.summary: Two side-by-side open-top full-depth hex bins on joined bases, capped and locked, staged with loose-item heaps in each to show dead AA batteries being collected/sorted for recycling. Note: tape battery terminals before storage as usual for recycling.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Two bins for dead AA batteries — I'll check the current build, bin options, and battery props to size them right.
